svg.title: ClickClick architecture: assistant, MCP and Android execution
svg.desc: PC assistants delegate complete Android tasks through nine MCP tools over stdio or Streamable HTTP. Control API manages tasks and the ClickClick harness runs its own configured models. Session retains state and evidence; Console shows traces and read-only previews. Compatible hosts can bridge HITL replies. Drivers act on Android, and external evaluators score outcomes.
